data.short_description: Tim Hortons is planning to renovate the former Starbucks space at 18154 Blanco Rd., Suite 106 in North San Antonio into a new 1,250-square-foot location, per a TDLR filing with an estimated construction cost of $200,000. Construction is expected to begin September 7, 2026, with completion targeted for November 18, 2026. Franchise owner Eduardo Castilleja confirmed the project to What Now San Antonio.

7 Brew Coffee is set for major expansion across the Orlando area as part of a 51-location deal, backed by franchisee DAI Restaurant Group in a $75 million investment. DAI Restaurant Group is a large franchisee of Wendy's and Taco Bell that is expanding into coffee. No specific addresses or opening dates for individual locations were provided.

Davanti, a new fine-dining French-inspired restaurant from celebrity chef Joshua Adam Garcia (Chef Jag), will open at 410 N Orange Ave in downtown Orlando with seating for approximately 80 guests. The Orlando CRA has approved funding to support the opening. Chef Garcia brings over 30 years of culinary experience specializing in Latin Fusion with French and Italian influences.

Tropix is also set to open at 100 S Orange Ave in downtown Orlando, with the Orlando CRA approving funding to support the concept alongside Davanti. No further details about Tropix's concept, menu, or opening date were provided in the article.

Toronto food influencer Marcello Varacalli is launching Cello's Cheesesteaks through a series of pop-ups as a first step toward opening a permanent cheesesteak restaurant in Toronto. No date or location for the first pop-up or permanent restaurant has been announced. The concept will focus on quality cheesesteaks developed through years of research and tasting.

data.location: 2101 Epcot Resorts Blvd, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
data.short_description: Jellyrolls, a dueling piano bar at Disney's Boardwalk, has closed after several decades of operation. Disney has announced a new concept called Hurly-Burly will replace it later in 2026. No specific closing date was provided.

data.location: 2101 Epcot Resorts Blvd, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
data.short_description: Disney has announced Hurly-Burly, a new concept replacing Jellyrolls at Disney's Boardwalk, themed around a historic seaside theater. By day it will offer family-friendly activities; by night it will transition to a 21-and-over live music venue with coastal-inspired cocktails and light bites. No specific opening date has been announced beyond later this year.

data.status: preparing to launch its second location
data.short_description: This Little Piggy BBQ is preparing to open a second location at Crooked Can Brewing's upcoming City Center Market food hall in Minneola, following eight years of operation at Plant Street Market in Winter Garden. The Minneola menu will include barbecue staples plus exclusive items like Smoked Turkey Breast and Burnt End Sausage. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: expected to welcome customers by the end of the summer
data.short_description: Agora, a Greek grab-and-go restaurant, is preparing to open a second location in Yorkville, Toronto, in a newly renovated space with a back patio offering approximately 40 seats. The new location will serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner and is expected to open by end of summer 2026. No exact address has been announced.

data.location: 5734 UTSA Blvd, Suite 101B, San Antonio, TX 78249
data.status: interior renovation planned, completion targeted for November 15, 2026
data.short_description: Pure Green is planning a new 1,115-square-foot juice bar location at 5734 UTSA Blvd., Suite 101B in San Antonio near UTSA, per a TDLR filing with an estimated construction cost of $200,000. Construction is scheduled to begin August 15, 2026, with completion targeted for November 15, 2026. Franchise owner Jennifer Barbaro confirmed the project to What Now San Antonio.

Weekend Craft Studio, the DIY creative studio founded by Michelle Beaton, officially closed and moved out of its third-floor space at Winsmith Mill Market on July 8, 2026. Beaton is relocating the business to a first-floor retail space in the same building under a new concept called The Craft Cafe. No further details about the closure were provided beyond the relocation.

The Craft Cafe is a new creative café concept opening at Winsmith Mill Market's first-floor retail space at 61 Endicott St. in Norwood, MA, founded by Michelle Beaton of Weekend Craft. The concept will combine a neighborhood coffee shop with a hands-on DIY studio offering crafts, workshops, and private events. Renovations are currently underway with no opening date announced.

data.status: opening its fourth restaurant before the end of 2026
data.short_description: European Street Cafe is opening its fourth location at Jacksonville's Riverfront Plaza before the end of 2026, joining existing locations in Riverside, San Marco, and Jacksonville Beach. The menu will largely mirror the other three locations with some additions, geared toward a faster-paced downtown lunch crowd. Owner Andy Zarka confirmed the opening to What Now.
